description: Eighth review, end-to-end oracle (rollout, minimal reproduction of what test/e2e-real.test.ts found): `npm test` fails at the repository root; `cd sub1 && npm test` then passes — sub1 is a nested project with its own package.json, so that run is its suite, not the repository's. Which project and which tests a run from a subdirectory runs depends on the runner's configuration lookup, which is not modelled: only a run from the repository's root proves the whole suite. WARN, never PASS.
